ArtworkTemplates.title: Artwork templates and guide
ArtworkTemplates.intro: Download a template for your size to see the cut line, bleed edge and safe area, then design on it.
ArtworkTemplates.unavailable: Templates aren't available right now. Please try again.
ArtworkTemplates.guideBleed: Bleed: extend your background and images {bleed} mm past the cut edge on every side.
ArtworkTemplates.guideSafe: Safe area: keep text and logos at least {safe} mm inside the cut edge.
ArtworkTemplates.guideColour: Colour: use CMYK. Screen (RGB) colours are converted for print and may look duller.
ArtworkTemplates.guideFonts: Fonts: embed all fonts, or convert text to outlines, when you export the PDF.
ArtworkTemplates.guideResolution: Resolution: keep images at {ppiWarn} ppi or more at printed size. Below {ppiError} ppi we ask you to fix the file.
